When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes…
For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
—because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit…

translations.web: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
translations.bsb: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
translations.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
translations.asv: And when he was come out of the boat, straightway there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
